text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф has claimed more than
seven
crowns: an unprecedented feat.
She has
cemented her place in history as
an emperor
among emperors.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What could possibly serve as a suitable
reward?
We think it over together
during a well-deserved
moment of
peace.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
